description: Add these configuration contributions to your package.json

gitr.claudeApi.endpoint.markdownDescription: Claude API Gateway endpoint URL (e.g., `https://claude-proxy-gateway-production-xxxxx.apigateway.YOUR_PROJECT.cloud.goog/analyze`). Obtain from GCP admin after infrastructure deployment.

gitr.claudeApi.retryAttempts.markdownDescription: Number of retry attempts for failed requests (default: 3)

gitr.claudeApi.retryDelay.markdownDescription: Initial delay between retries in milliseconds (uses exponential backoff)

gitr.claudeApi.enableCaching.markdownDescription: Enable local caching of Claude API responses to reduce costs and improve performance

gitr.claudeApi.cacheExpirationDays.markdownDescription: Number of days to cache Claude API responses (default: 7 days)

commands.description: Set up Claude API key for repository analysis

commands.description: Verify Claude API configuration and connectivity
